description: Through ADODB.Connection (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0, Mode adModeRead, Data Source set through Connection.Properties) on r-sort-3b-lg (General): reads the ID sequences of 9 statements on T: ORDER BY K, ID; ORDER BY K DESC, ID; LIKE with % and * and _ and a class; the no-wildcard LIKE; and the half-open range. Asks whether the ADO provider's wildcard mode and the same-value order and sets agree with the DAO lane (the lg-like-vs-range probe), kept as a separate client lane. This probe loads ADODB instead of DBEngine, so it replaces EngineLite and FinishLite by the same file, module and close records.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
